mapper.select: select d.*, (select count(*) from nad_program_major m where m.department_id = d.id) as program_count from nad_department d where d.university_id = #{universityId} order by d.sort_order, d.name
select id from nad_department where university_id = #{universityId} and lower(name) = lower(#{name}) limit 1
select count(*) from nad_program_major where department_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into nad_department (university_id, name, name_cn, sort_order, create_by, create_time) values (#{universityId}, #{name}, #{nameCn}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_department set name = #{name}, name_cn = #{nameCn}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
